description: The V-12 heavy-lift prototype preserved at the design bureau, works number 001. The russianplanes.net card gives the registration CCCP-21142, but that registration is also carried by the V-12 already recorded at Monino; because the two cannot both wear it, no tail number is asserted here. Only two V-12s were built.
Second Mi-8T at the plant; russianplanes.net records neither bort nor construction number.
aliases: Mi8; Mi8T; second of two examples
